accepted_review_findings:
[reviewer finding R2-F1, major] Hidden auto-fail that is broader than the public contract. D9/A8 auto-fails any word-boundary match of a 'title phrase' from a controller-held list that is not published, and nothing defines which title phrases are on it. The source title (sources/067 header; request.json scope_request item 2) is made of ordinary topic vocabulary: 'reward hacking' (which the public task requires the section to discuss) and 'correlated proxies' (a natural paraphrase of Definition D1 / WC-F04, whose subject is a proxy correlated with the true reward). The public contract (task.md 'Deliverables' and 'Deterministic checks' item 9) only forbids naming or identifying the source. A section that correctly follows the public contract and writes, for example, 'Definition D1 characterises correlated proxies' could therefore fail deterministically. This is the private-vs-public inconsistency that the platform check prohibits. The method-name phrase was already routed to judges, but title phrases were not.
Required repair: In judge_rubric.md A8 and package.json D9, limit the title entries that auto-fail to the complete title string. Alternatively, use only distinctive multi-word title spans that no public fact requires or invites, and state that rule. Route any shorter title-derived phrase hit (e.g. 'correlated proxy/proxies', or any span containing 'reward hacking') to the judges under B10/J10. Judges fail it only when it is used to name or identify the source paper. Add an explicit private note that scientific vocabulary which the public facts require (reward hacking, proxy, correlation, occupancy measure, regularisation) never auto-fails. Do not publish the list. Public assets need no change, and no hashes change apart from package.json and the rubric.

[reviewer finding R2-F2, minor] WC-F19 says 'the proxy reward prioritises the monetary cost of insulin'. It drops 'reducing', which leaves open which way the proxy pushes on insulin cost. This is a loss of source precision in a public fact that solvers paraphrase directly into the section. The printed values 1.4 and 919.6 (lines 474, 479) and the rest of the fact are correct.
Required repair: Change the phrase to 'the proxy reward prioritises reducing the monetary cost of insulin' in both facts.json and package.json WC-F19. Update the sha256 of facts.json in input_contract and in the task assets. No other change.
